definitions: To grip (flesh) tightly between the thumb and forefinger or between two surfaces.
To steal something, especially something of small value.
To cause a sharp, uncomfortable sensation.
To restrict or limit something, especially money or resources.
examples: She pinched his arm to get his attention.
Someone pinched my wallet from my bag.
These new shoes pinch my toes.
The rising costs will pinch our budget.
The police pinched him for shoplifting.
